Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.if: shell guard on the first script line of every step (the condition has no Drone filter; each step shows success instead of skipped)
